Fantastic Food
Nov 2019 • Family
Loved this local gem we spotted from our hotel window. Busy with locals and fast efficient service from friendly staff.

Food tasted great and was good value for a family including 2 teens. Slightly more expensive than other places we have tried but still well within budget with 4 dishes + rice + drinks coming to 376,000VND

We even got adventurous and tried fried frog with chilli which was something different for us.

Great atmosphere and worth seeking out.

Brilliant
Feb 2019 • Family
This is not a place you would either probably find or choose, however it is really great.
Our nephew lives in Saigon and regularly eats here. Our daughter states this was her favourite restaurant of her trip.
It is a locals restaurant..dogs and cats run around the place..its noisy, the chairs are blue plastic ...... and the food is great .....and incredible value. 5 mains, 3 beers and a side came to £9.50!
If you want comfort and nice surroundings, give this place a wide berth!
If you want to eat with the locals and eat what they eat...dive in!

Fantastic fun
Apr 2019 • Couples
Watch the locals fill up on cheap Tiger beer and become increasingly animated.

Dinner for two with beers is about 200,000 vnd.

The beef with lime is amazing. Five spice pork tough but tasty and garlic fried rice very good.

Big chunks of ice are put in your beer glass to keep things cool.

Highly recommended for a non tourist night out. Just around the corner from Sunland Hotel.

Great food at a great price
Jan 2018 • Couples
We ate here last night. It is a restaurant mainly frequented by locals but we were made very welcome. Th menu is in Vietnamese and English. The food was Excellent...some of the best we've had in Vietnam. It was freshly cooked, nicely served and delicious. The beer was cheap and cold. It is not a place for a romantic dinner for two, but if you are looking for a first class meal in a buzzy atmosphere at a great value price then make your way here! (150,000VND for two, including 4 bottles of cold beer!)
